label: CP7_OW09_WHOLE_LIST_NATIVE8
install: PASS: all eight readers replaced as their verified owners (the owner-CREATE fix of the first failure held); complete preuse removal ran, cp6_restored true, advisor_gate true

cases.OW09_MATERIAL_COUNT_DOCUMENTS_WHOLE_LIST: INCOMPLETE: cases.py:266 fixture save('10') refused by the count writer with CP7_COUNT_NO_DIFFERENCE (cp7_material.count_command line 32), before any list read

cause: Test design, not product. The fixture saved every count document with the same physical quantity (8). The writer compares a count with the stock at the count's own time (cp7_material.count_lines at physical_at) and refuses a count with no difference. N1 was posted (10 to 8) and then reversed; the reversal is a later movement, so at the shared count time the position still holds 8, and the second count of 8 has no difference. The guard is right and stays.
fix: Each count document in the fixture counts its own quantity: N1 8 (posted, reversed), N10 7 (posted), drafts N2/N11/N3/N03 at 6/5/4/3 against the 7 that N10 posts, so every document has a difference. The list oracle, statuses (one reversed, one posted, four drafts) and every assertion are unchanged. SOURCE.json refreshed; scripts/cp7-src unchanged (e7701eaa).
